name: Dumbbell Row
common_faults: rotating the torso excessively (reduces back isolation)
shrugging into the traps at the top
partial ROM losing lat stretch at the bottom

substitutions.note: bilateral; higher load ceiling; adds axial demand
constant tension; seated; bilateral or unilateral

resistance_profile: hardest at the start of the pull; good lat stretch at the bottom with elbow fully extended

provenance.notes: Unilateral allows greater ROM than barbell row. Chest-supported variant removes spinal demand entirely. SFR heuristic.
